title: Indiana Democrats nominate Beau Bayh for secretary of state
text:
SOUTH BEND, Indiana — Tall, young, brimming with confidence and low-key Midwest swagger, a scion of the Bayh political family recently campaigned for Indiana’s secretary of state and in the process, striking fear in the heart of the state’s powerful GOP while wooing Hoosiers with a message of kicking out corrupt politicians.
